read: Read bytes from a file descriptor.
write: Write bytes to a file descriptor.
open: Open a file (older form of openat).
openat: Open a file relative to a directory file descriptor.
close_range: Close a range of file descriptors.
fstat: Get file status of an open file descriptor.
lstat: Get file status without following symlinks.
newfstatat: Get file status relative to a directory fd (modern stat).
lseek: Move the read/write offset of a file descriptor.
pread64: Read from a file at a given offset without moving the offset.
pwrite64: Write to a file at a given offset without moving the offset.
access: Check user permissions for a file.
faccessat: Check permissions relative to a directory fd.
faccessat2: Check permissions relative to a directory fd (with flags).
readlink: Read the target of a symbolic link.
readlinkat: Read a symbolic link relative to a directory fd.
fchdir: Change working directory to an open directory fd.
mkdirat: Create a directory relative to a directory fd.
unlinkat: Delete a file or directory relative to a directory fd.
renameat: Rename a file relative to directory fds.
renameat2: Rename a file relative to directory fds, with flags.
linkat: Create a hard link relative to directory fds.
symlinkat: Create a symbolic link relative to a directory fd.
fchmod: Change permissions of an open file.
fchmodat: Change permissions relative to a directory fd.
fchown: Change owner of an open file.
fchownat: Change owner relative to a directory fd.
lchown: Change owner of a symlink itself.
ftruncate: Truncate an open file to a given length.
fallocate: Pre-allocate disk space for a file.
fsync: Flush a file's data and metadata to disk.
fdatasync: Flush a file's data to disk.
flock: Apply or remove an advisory lock on an open file.
fcntl: Manipulate a file descriptor (flags, locks, duplication).
ioctl: Device-specific control operation on a file descriptor.
dup2: Duplicate a file descriptor to a given number.
dup3: Duplicate a file descriptor to a given number, with flags.
fadvise64: Give the kernel advice about file access patterns.
sendfile: Copy data between file descriptors inside the kernel.
copy_file_range: Copy a range of bytes between files inside the kernel.
splice: Move data between a pipe and a file descriptor.
lgetxattr: Read an extended attribute of a symlink.
fgetxattr: Read an extended attribute of an open file.
fsetxattr: Set an extended attribute of an open file.
flistxattr: List extended attributes of an open file.
llistxattr: List extended attributes of a symlink.
fstatfs: Get filesystem statistics for an open file.
mmap: Map files or anonymous memory into the address space.
mremap: Resize or move a memory mapping.
madvise: Give the kernel advice about memory usage.
msync: Flush a memory-mapped file to disk.
execve: Execute a new program, replacing the current process image.
execveat: Execute a program relative to a directory fd.
exit_group: Terminate all threads of the process.
wait4: Wait for a child process to change state.
waitid: Wait for a child process to change state (extended).
vfork: Create a child process that shares memory until exec.
clone: Create a child process or thread.
clone3: Create a child process or thread (modern interface used by pthread_create).
kill: Send a signal to a process.
tgkill: Send a signal to a specific thread.
prlimit64: Get or set resource limits of a process.
sched_getaffinity: Get which CPUs a thread may run on.
sched_setaffinity: Set which CPUs a thread may run on.
set_tid_address: Register where the kernel clears the thread ID on exit (thread startup).
set_robust_list: Register a list of robust futexes (thread startup, used by pthreads).
futex: Fast user-space locking: wait/wake used by mutexes, condition variables and thread joins.
arch_prctl: Set architecture-specific thread state (e.g. the TLS register).
prctl: Operations on a process (names, seccomp, capabilities, etc.).
uname: Get system name and kernel version.
getrandom: Get random bytes from the kernel.
getcpu: Get the CPU the thread is running on.
socketpair: Create a pair of connected sockets.
bind: Assign an address to a socket.
listen: Mark a socket as accepting connections.
accept: Accept a connection on a socket.
accept4: Accept a connection on a socket, with flags.
connect: Connect a socket to an address.
sendto: Send a message on a socket.
recvfrom: Receive a message from a socket.
sendmsg: Send a message on a socket (with control data).
recvmsg: Receive a message from a socket (with control data).
shutdown: Shut down part of a socket connection.
getpeername: Get the address of the connected peer.
poll: Wait for events on file descriptors.
ppoll: Wait for events on file descriptors (with signal mask).
select: Wait for file descriptors to become ready.
pselect6: Wait for file descriptors to become ready (with signal mask).
epoll_ctl: Add/remove file descriptors watched by epoll.
epoll_pwait: Wait for epoll events (with signal mask).
inotify_init1: Create an inotify instance to watch files.
ptrace: Trace and control another process (debugger interface).
unshare: Move the process into new namespaces.
bpf: Load and manage eBPF programs and maps in the kernel.
finit_module: Load a kernel module from a file descriptor.
kexec_load: Load a new kernel for later execution.
userfaultfd: Create a file descriptor for handling page faults in user space.
io_uring_setup: Set up an io_uring asynchronous I/O context.
open_by_handle_at: Open a file by its filesystem handle.
